snippet.title: Honeymancer 🍯 2025 Trailer - Early Access
snippet.description:
Honeymancer is releasing to Early Access on March 27 2025! By buying it you support the development and help make it the best game it can bee🐝

Play as a Bear Witch and protect nature with your Honey Magic. Help your bee buddies make honey by planting flowers, leave your comfort zone and befriend your animal neighbours, and stop waves of evil robots from destroying the forest! 

💛 Wishlist Honeymancer on Steam 💛 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2114330/Honeymancer/

Follow the development on twitter 🐝
https://www.twitter.com/honeymancer

Developer: Lukas Lundin 🌻

Music : Stijn Van Wakeren 🧸
http://www.stijnvanwakeren.com/
